heading: Voluntary commitments to reduce industrial energy intensity

tree.heading: Definition of energy intensity
tree.text: In this section, the term “energy intensity” means the primary energy consumed for each unit of physical output in an industrial process.

tree.heading: Voluntary agreements
tree.text: The Secretary may enter into voluntary agreements with one or more persons in industrial sectors that consume significant quantities of primary energy for each unit of physical output to reduce the energy intensity of the production activities of the persons.

tree.heading: Goal
tree.text: Voluntary agreements under this section shall have as a goal the reduction of energy intensity by not less than 2.5 percent each year during the period of calendar years 2007 through 2016.

tree.heading: Recognition
tree.text: The Secretary, in cooperation with other appropriate Federal agencies, shall develop mechanisms to recognize and publicize the achievements of participants in voluntary agreements under this section.

tree.heading: Technical assistance
tree.text: A person that enters into an agreement under this section and continues to make a good faith effort to achieve the energy efficiency goals specified in the agreement shall be eligible to receive from the Secretary a grant or technical assistance, as appropriate, to assist in the achievement of those goals.

tree.heading: Report
tree.text: Not later than each of June 30, 2012, and June 30, 2017, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report that—

children.text: evaluates the success of the voluntary agreements under this section; and
provides independent verification of a sample of the energy savings estimates provided by participating firms.
